p: If you're making a night of it, you're in one of the best parts of Leeds for it. The Hyde Park Picture House, a short stroll away, is a beautifully preserved Edwardian cinema with gas lamps still in the auditorium, and it's a lovely way to spend an afternoon before an evening gig. Headingley, home to the famous cricket and rugby grounds, is also close by, with plenty of pubs and places to eat.

Gig tips: smaller shows can sell out quickly, so buy tickets in advance rather than hoping for some on the door. Keep an eye on the support acts, too, as the Brudenell has a habit of hosting bands just before they get big. The city centre and Leeds railway station are within reach by bus, taxi or a decent walk, so getting home is straightforward.
Even without a gig, the bar and games room make it a great place to start or finish a day exploring this side of the city.
